findings.claim: The round-2 fix for the missing-kind crash was appended to plan.md:917 but the same paragraph still prescribes `kind_name = kinds_by_code.get(code).name or ""` (which raises on None), and the new fallback folder `<kód>_` contradicts Error Handling at plan.md:920 (`<code>_neznamy_druh/`), so the implementer gets two incompatible instructions for the same case.
findings.fix: Replace the step (3) expression with `kind_name = meta.kind_name or (kinds_by_code.get(code).name if code in kinds_by_code else None)` and pick ONE folder name for an unknown code (either `<code>_` or `<code>_neznamy_druh/`) used consistently in Implementation Detail, Error Handling and the AC.
